# ADR-036 — Primary-device eligibility is surfaced in Settings, never auto-corrected (no automatic promotion)

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

Primary-device eligibility is surfaced, never auto-corrected. ADR-019 stands — no automatic promotion — so when the current device is revoked, has notifications disabled, or is not primary, Settings names the reason instead of silently scheduling nothing (Checkpoint 5, user-approved 2026-08-18)
